title: My 10yo son designed a 120 FPS retro platformer featuring historicallegends & 50 rage-inducing troll stages. Our family helped him make it  Marinext2100 is out!
author: Certain_Challenge395
selftext:
Hi

I wanted to share a milestone our family is incredibly proud of. My 10-year-old son has been

dreaming of creating his own classic 2D retro platformer, obsessed with old-school arcade

games.

With some technical and AI guidance from me, and countless hours of playtesting by my wife

and our 6-year-old daughter, we finally brought Marinext 2100 to life — and it just passed

production approval on Google Play!

 What we built:

• 100 Handcrafted Cyberpunk Stages + 20 Giant Mechanical Bosses.

• 50 Rage-Inducing "Troll Mode" Levels designed for hardcore reflex & puzzle lovers (fake floors,

sudden traps).

• 14 Historical & Futuristic Legends: Play as Ottoman Sultans (Mehmed II, Selim I, Suleiman),

Cyber Knights, Cyber Samurai, and Modern Special Forces!

• Full Character Studio: Equip gliding wings, cyber visors, helmets, and glowing auras.

• 120 FPS Ultra-Smooth Engine + 100% Offline Playability.

• 9 Languages supported natively.

He reads every single comment and review! If you enjoy precision platformers or rage games,

we'd love for you to check it out and leave honest feedback.

**Google Play Link:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cgstudiohome.marinext2100](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cgstudiohome.marinext2100)

**Web Site:** [https://cgstudiohome.github.io/](https://cgstudiohome.github.io/)

**Playable Link:** [https://cgstudiohome.github.io/play/](https://cgstudiohome.github.io/play/)

Thanks for supporting indie creators!

replies.body: "I was fired from my job, I lost my kids and my family, and am homeless now. So this game was a one-shotted prompt by the last sentence my grandmother whispered before she passed away"

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Certain_Challenge395 please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.
